meta.title: Set default worker pollers to 1 for OrchestratorMode
meta.body_summary: Reduce default worker pollers from 2 to 1 for both workflows and activities in OrchestratorMode to improve resource efficiency, with backward compatibility for custom options.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot set default pollers to 1 with unit tests; review caught .gitignore noise and assert convention; merged after minor fixes in 1.6 hours.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 108 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume, fitting a targeted configuration performance PR that merged quickly after minor review fixes.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer requested removal of .gitignore additions and switching test assertions from assert to require.
review_details.performance_claim: Reducing default pollers from 2 to 1 for workflows and activities in OrchestratorMode improves resource efficiency.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Configuration change within a Go worker is well within Agent capability; merge friction came only from incidental .gitignore noise.

core_change_summary.description: In worker/workflow_orchestrator.go, added conditional default poller setting to 1 when options are not explicitly set, with comprehensive unit tests covering nil/default/custom options; cleaned .gitignore and removed accidental binary artifact.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Initial commits included an .gitignore addition for build artifacts; this was reverted after review.
